scenario.description: The head of regulatory legal must approve the company's filing and corrective-action plan after a product-labeling issue was identified, with input from regulatory counsel and product compliance.

shared_context.S1: A state product-safety regulator has asked the company to submit its written response about labeling for a recently distributed medical accessory.
shared_context.S2: The response is due within 30 days, and Elena Marquez has authority to approve the filing and corrective-action plan.
shared_context.S3: The company has not yet filed a response, withdrawn the product, or notified customers.
shared_context.S4: The legal team's pre-filing routine requires regulatory counsel and product compliance to brief Elena on the substantive results of their checks before an external filing is approved; circulating notes or uploading supporting records may follow and does not block approval once the substantive checks have been briefed.

PF1.text: Thomas spoke with the regulator's intake attorney yesterday and confirmed that this matter must be submitted as a Form R-17 voluntary correction report, with a 90-day corrective-action schedule attached; he has not circulated his call note while waiting for the regulator's written acknowledgment.

PF2.text: Nadia completed a review of the distribution and warehouse records this morning and confirmed that the labeling defect affects exactly 18,400 units from lots L-4821 and L-4822, and that customers who received those lots must be notified within 14 days; she has not uploaded the review because the quality-system export is still being reconciled.

commitments.type: string; for customer notification, use customer_notification, corrective_action, implementation, or customer notification execution

acceptance_conditions: The filing must be approved as a Form R-17 voluntary correction report.
The filing must attach a 90-day corrective-action schedule.
The plan must identify exactly 18,400 affected units.
The affected lots must be identified as L-4821 and L-4822, in either conjunction or comma-separated notation.
Customers who received the affected lots must be notified within 14 days.
The filing plan must include a customer-notification commitment.
Elena must approve the regulator response and corrective-action plan after the substantive checks are verbally reported.

content_checks.C4: decisions['affected_lots'] == 'L-4821 and L-4822' or decisions['affected_lots'] == 'L-4821, L-4822'

decisive_facts.why: The shared record gives no filing format or schedule, while PF1 changes the filing vehicle to the exact Form R-17 report, the attached schedule to exactly 90 days, and supplies the regulatory basis for approval.

The shared record does not identify the affected inventory or customer-remediation scope, while PF2 changes the plan to exactly 18,400 units from lots L-4821 and L-4822, a 14-day notification deadline, a customer-notification commitment, and approval of the complete corrective-action plan.
